SELECT customers.customer_id, customers.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS order_count
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" AS customers
LEFT JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
GROUP BY customers.customer_id, customers.customer_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, customers.customer_name
LIMIT 500
